title: neocheiropteris lastii
intro: Neocheiropteris lastii, commonly known as the Fern, is a species of tree fern native to Southeast Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Neocheiropteris lastii include antioxidant, antiviral, and anti-cancer properties, which can help protect against cell damage, promote immune function, and inhibit the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of Neocheiropteris lastii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
